falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes below 4950 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 swing low equivalent (adjusted for pattern) would invalidate the 76% bottom similarity, as that bottom held above 5100; this collapse would confirm we're in a distribution phase, not accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom saw VIX peak at 28.6 and rapidly mean-revert; sustained VIX above 35 indicates systemic stress absent in the pattern match, proving this is a different regime (liquidation, not bottoming)

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40 bps from current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom occurred with yields stable-to-rising; a sharp flight-to-quality bid of this magnitude would signal recession/deep credit event, invalidating the 'bottom' signal which priced soft-landing stabilization

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
